## BudgetLimits  (type-only)
type BudgetLimits = Partial<Record<Exclude<keyof GpuCounts, 'byMethod'>, number>> & {

};

## FakeBuffer  (type-only)
interface FakeBuffer {
    label?: string;
    size: number;
    usage: number;
    destroyed: boolean;
    readonly mapState: GPUBufferMapState;
    readonly data: Uint8Array;
    mapAsync(mode: number, offset?: number, size?: number): Promise<void>;
    getMappedRange(offset?: number, size?: number): ArrayBuffer;
    unmap(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

    size: number;
}

## FakeDevice  (type-only)
interface FakeDevice {
    readonly device: GPUDevice;
    readonly buffers: FakeBuffer[];
    readonly textures: FakeTexture[];
    readonly bindGroups: FakeBindGroup[];
    readonly writes: {
        buffer: FakeBuffer;
        offset: number;
        bytes: number;
    }[];
    readonly writeData: {
        data: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView;
        dataOffset: number;
    }[];
    readonly textureWrites: {
        texture: FakeTexture;
        bytesPerRow: number;
        rowsPerImage: number;
        mipLevel: number;
        size: number[];
        data: ArrayBufferView | ArrayBuffer;
    }[];
    readonly passes: FakePass[];
    readonly textureCopies: {
        src: FakeTexture;
        dst: FakeTexture;
        afterPasses: number;
    }[];
    readonly bufferCopies: FakeBufferCopy[];
    readonly querySets: FakeQuerySet[];
    readonly submits: number;
    readonly bundles: FakeBundle[];
    readonly calls: number;
    readonly bundleCalls: number;
    markView(name: string | null): void;
    readonly callsByView: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
    runPass: ((pass: FakePass) => void) | null;
    readonly errors: string[];
    readonly lost: Promise<GPUDeviceLostInfo>;
    loseDevice(reason?: GPUDeviceLostReason, message?: string): void;
}

## FakeHapticCall  (type-only)
type FakeHapticCall = {
    readonly op: 'impact';
    readonly style: HapticImpact;
} | {
    readonly op: 'notification';
    readonly kind: HapticNotification;
} | {
    readonly op: 'vibrate';
    readonly ms: number;
};

## FakeHost  (type-only)
interface FakeHost extends Host {
    readonly lifecycle: HostLifecycle;
    readonly haptics: HostHaptics;
    readonly safeArea: HostSafeArea;
    readonly memory: StorageLike | null;
    setState(state: HostLifecycleState): void;
    setSafeArea(insets: Partial<HostInsets>): void;
    readonly hapticCalls: readonly FakeHapticCall[];
    readonly fullscreenCalls: readonly {
        readonly lockLandscape?: boolean;
    }[];
    readonly opened: readonly {
        readonly url: string;
        readonly activation: LinkActivation;
    }[];
    readonly copied: readonly string[];
    readonly wakeLock: FakeWakeLock;
    readonly pendingFrames: number;
    readonly frameTime: number;
    runFrame(timeMs?: number): number;
}

## GpuCounts  (type-only)
interface GpuCounts {
    commands: number;
    draw: number;
    drawIndexed: number;
    drawIndirect: number;
    drawIndexedIndirect: number;
    setPipeline: number;
    setBindGroup: number;
    setVertexBuffer: number;
    setIndexBuffer: number;
    dispatch: number;
    beginRenderPass: number;
    beginComputePass: number;
    executeBundles: number;
    submit: number;
    writeBuffer: number;
    writeBufferBytes: number;
    writeTexture: number;
    copies: number;
    createBuffer: number;
    createTexture: number;
    createBindGroup: number;
    createOther: number;
    byMethod: Record<string, number>;
}

## PassCommand  (type-only)
type PassCommand = {
    op: 'setPipeline';
    pipeline: unknown;
} | {
    op: 'setBindGroup';
    index: number;
    group: unknown;
    offsets: number[];
} | {
    op: 'draw';
    vertices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
} | {
    op: 'drawIndexed';
    indices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
    firstIndex?: number;
} | {
    op: 'dispatch';
    x: number;
    y: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'drawIndexedIndirect' | 'drawIndirect' | 'dispatchIndirect';
    buffer: unknown;
    offset: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'multiDrawIndexedIndirect';
    buffer: unknown;
    offset: number;
    maxDrawCount: number;
    countBuffer?: unknown;
    countOffset?: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'executeBundles';
    bundles: FakeBundle[];
} | {
    op: 'other';
    name: string;
    args?: number[];
    slot?: number;
    buffer?: unknown;
    offset?: number;
    size?: number;
};
